notes.title: Major Update v.2.0 & Steam Winter Sales
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25362463/e186714c7eeec667a0b58ed5bb93cf5dfb852da5.png

Greetings fellow players,
We are pleased to announce that
  Toricky's version .2.0 is here!  

Thanks to all our community's support and feedbacks which let us improve Toricky up to this point!

This version introduces 
a new EASY MODE function for players who are not used to action-games 
and want to focus on exploration and puzzle solving.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25362463/7fbdba0bf92ca4ff2d149fa2bcf4bf27051db000.png

You can activate the EASY MODE anytime by pressing on F2.
When the EASY MODE is activated, you will not take damage anymore (except instant-death) but Perfect Medals and Clear Time will not be recorded.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25362463/83319088431af84d36ed4e8e34bff97e54b648ff.png

Other updates:


Leveldesign & Boss Adjustments
Huge Optimization Improvement
Menus Enhancements


*If your game's version is 1.5.0 or below, please update your version to 2.0.0.


Also,
 we're celebrating this update & Steam Winter Sales  
with an exceptional discount:

50% OFF discount on Toricky ($7.49) !

Thank you for all of your support and feedbacks.
Please Like, Share & Enjoy!


http://store.steampowered.com/app/477720/

 Atelier Melon-Kissa

notes.title: [Major Update] Toricky version 1.5 !
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/dd3cc0a11482b314ce37d91c2d777551ed19d1b8.png

Greetings fellow players,
 We are pleased to announce that Toricky's v.1.5 is here!  

Thanks to all our community's support and feedbacks which let us improve Toricky up to this point!

The latest version is coming with a LOT of new features!

 
    Leveldesign & Boss Adjustments

    Graphical Optimization Improvement

    Visual Enhancements

    Usanins (NPC) Healpoints
Usanins are special characters you save by collecting Pink Crystars. When you've saved an Usanin in a Zone, he/she will appear to support you by healing all your Hearts.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/6083de1d0bc5d12d17894f5d6defad14bed7454c.png

    Additional Weapons

    New Rewards for Perfect Medal hunters
By collecting Perfect Medals, you'll unlock special Bonus.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/17d6a36a16fbe36c9cf4992bfc9a154ef50aeb16.jpg

    Next Goal Guidance
As soon as an important mission is required for the progression of the story, an [!] icon will appear on the map to guide you to your next destination

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/9f52ce37b9d5e2ca2b6a54f6ad317301551272f9.png

    Animated Tutorials

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/7f4b6494d2b332d35a366ebd6390c43d4bdffbea.png

    Minor Bug Fix

 

*If your game's version is 1.3.1 or below, please update your version to 1.5.0.

We hope you will enjoy our game!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/477720/

 Atelier Melon-Kissa

notes.title: [Major Update] Toricky version 1.2 & Weeklong Deal 20%OFF !
notes.content:
Greetings fellow players,
 We are pleased to announce that Toricky's v.1.2 is finally here!  

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/af2b31af46d829b691592fbaca1a54828019fe07.png

Thanks to all for your support for Toricky.

Let's kick off with an updated version of the Trailer!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eRZwGHVTJH8

As promised, the new version is coming with a lot of improvements!

 
    Screen Readability

As the game was praised for its cute and colorful visuals, we also observed that some players are encountering difficulties to distinguish interactive from decorative elements.
That's why we proceed large scale graphical adjustments to improve the screen's readability!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/27b6bb8cc1d22912eb17c6af9764b13eda48b8a1.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/acb733871235130079adbbea6ae18a0a251cf43a.png

    Graphic Enhancements

We also took this opportunity to upgrade many graphical elements of the game including the lighting.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25362463/eb602f3cd4aec5bb7481309d3e6d8aedf2d82878.png

    Dimensional Gates Shortcut System

Once you have visited a Zone. You can select the Zone's Gate Icon on the Crystar Palace (Main Hub) 's map to teleport directly to the selected Zone's Dimentional Gate (Entrance).

notes.title: Toricky Updated to ver. 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

I am pleased to announce that we have updated the game based on the feedback and recommendations of our community. (version 1.0.3)

I'd like to take this opportunity to thank those who gave feedback and to apologize for any inconveniences caused. We are a small team behind Toricky, but we are doing best to improve your gameplay experience! 

Here's what's new: 

Further FPS optimization 
Inputs updated to be more responsive 
New loading system -tips added on level load 
Additional in-game hints added so the player can understand the mechanics(dash is very important!)
Enemies difficulty reduced
Language selection bug fix(version 1.0.3) 
Buggy "check point tutorial" fix 


Gamepad users Please note: 

For the moment we only support the XBox controller. 
If you have issues with the XBox controller do not hesitate to contact us and we will look into your issues 
Please note that you can re-assign gamepad buttons in the options menu (F1) more information   here


We will continue to listen to your feedback, so do not hesitate to leave us some feedback!

notes.title: [News] Toricky Development Stories : Soundtrack & Medley
notes.content:
Hi, Everyone,
My name is Arashi, and I'm the Creative Director of Toricky!

http://otakumaker.com/images/TokyoIndieFest.jpg

This time, I'd like to talk about the game's musics!
I think music is a key component of a game's universe and it was very important for me to have a soundtrack for Toricky which matches perfectly the game's world!

During 2016 we had the chance to be contacted by the label Scarlet Moon Records, who offered us the opportunity to work with two amazing composers.

Dale North :A talented composer for video games and digital media based in San Francisco,

http://otakumaker.com/images/Dale_North_01.jpg

and

Hiroki Kikuta :The legendary composer of Secret of Mana, who also worked on many other famous games like Soul Calibur V or SEGA's Shining Series.

http://otakumaker.com/images/Hiroki_Kikuta_01.jpg

Toricky is a Platform-Adventure game featuring Toricky a green exploring bird always looking for new adventures! I really wanted the game's Main Theme to set the tone for the player.

Kikuta-san envisioned a treasure hunter in the sky, which fits perfectly to the character of Toricky who loves treasures! Resulting in the epic theme “Treasures beyond the Sky”.

I'm a great admirer of the sound design on Nintendo's Mario and Zelda Games; especially how the musics are not used only for an artistic purpose but as an integral part of the Gameplay.

While working on Toricky's soundtrack, Dale took special care to make each track illustrate the situation the player is ingame.

http://otakumaker.com/images/Atelier_Melon_Kissa2.jpg

Also, Toricky's world is strongly influenced by Japanese folklore and myths. I felt it important to highlight this atmosphere but without slipping into the Samurai/Ninja ambience. It is with this in mind that you'll find many discrete inclusion of japanese instruments like Biwa in the game's Fantasy Musics.

However, for one particular theme, we took our inspiration from WagakkiBand, a famous musical group from Japan which plays awesome Rock musics using traditional Japanese instruments.

I'll leave you to discover what track on your own!

Toricky's release is for very soon! Hope you'll enjoy the musical universe of Toricky while saving Crystars!

notes.title: [News] Toricky Development Stories 2015/2016
notes.content:
Hi, Everyone,
My name is Arashi, and I'm the Creative Director of Toricky!

http://otakumaker.com/images/TokyoIndieFest.jpg

One day, Guillaume, an indie developper who is the programmer of Toricky came to me 
with a conceptual mini-game featuring a little Bird carrying and throwing boxes.
When I saw this flying character using physics to play with objects, I had an intuition that we could
be able to create a very unique mechanics for a great Platform Game.
That's how the project Toricky started! It was about 2 years ago.

http://otakumaker.com/images/Atelier_Melon_Kissa1.jpg

At Atelier Melon-Kissa,  my indie game studio based in Osaka (Japan), we love Mangas and Animes. This is one reason we think characters are very important elements of a game.
For Toricky, I created many colorful characters with very unique personality for each of them.

http://otakumaker.com/images/Atelier_Melon_Kissa2.jpg

When designing the game, we were drawing inspirations as much from Old School Platform games, especially the Sonic and Mario games which I am a great fan, than Action-Adventure games.
One of our aims is to render in 2D the feeling of Nintendo 64 Exploration-Platform games!
The world of Toricky is also greatly influenced by Japanese folklore and myths.

http://otakumaker.com/images/TokyoIndieFest2.jpg

We exhibited the very first Prototype of Toricky at the Tokyo Indie Fest 2015, a big indie game show which took place in Akihabara, the holy land of Japanese Pop-Culture!
It was a very simple version of the game with small stages, few enemies and a treasure to find.
As soon as we saw hundreds of gamers visiting our booth and really enjoying Toricky's refreshing gameplay, we realized that we might have something that could become an amazing game!

It's very important for Atelier Melon-Kissa to create a complete game experience where gameplay, characters, story, and musics interact with one another! 
Level designing the game is a big challenge as we are creating immense zones structured around complex puzzles. Guillaume is also having a hard time programming the various crazy Boss Fights the game is featuring!

 When Arashi first contacted me with a partnership offer, he described our future endeavours as 'extra-professional projects involving mini games'. 
At the time I immedietley said yes! 'Why not?' I thought 'Shouldn't take too much of my time'. 
I had no idea what I was getting myself into! 
Toricky took a life of its own and evolved into the game it is today. 
Take it from me, there is nothing 'Mini' about it.

In 2016 we were joined by two amazing composers, Dale North and  Hiroki Kikuta, the legendary composer of Secret of Mana. They created amazing musics which added a whole new dimension to Toricky's world!

It's hard for me to believe that the game is going to be released in a couple of weeks.
We're hoping you'll enjoy exploring Toricky's world!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/477720
Please visit the store page for more info.
Thank you for all of your support.

Atelier Melon-Kissa & OtakuMaker.com Studio
